purpose: Targeted coverage-first A/B for the first non-pass task after replacing Writer PDF export's opaque params wrapper with a reusable explicit-path or active-document same-basename contract.
change_scope: Expose document.export_pdf through an Adapter-owned direct schema supporting either an explicit path or same_basename=true derived from the active document URL. Leave model, prompt, routing, VM, evaluator, and all other tool behavior unchanged.

implementation_evidence.hypothesis: The model already selects document.export_pdf, but the legacy opaque params wrapper causes it to emit an invalid empty string. A direct semantic choice between an explicit destination and same_basename=true should let the model express the instruction while the Adapter deterministically derives the latter from the active saved document URL.
implementation_evidence.counterfactual: Schema, worker, and LiteAgent tests use field-notes.odt and quarterly-review.pdf in unrelated directories. They cover explicit paths, active-document same-basename derivation, an unsaved-document error, direct top-level dispatch, exactly-one validation, and rejection of the old empty params wrapper.
implementation_evidence.changed_source_leakage_scan: No current task UUID, episode ID, task filename, full instruction, golden value, or evaluator expected state appears in changed runtime or test sources.
implementation_evidence.prior_v29_outcome: evaluator 0.0 after 30 steps; the model selected document.export_pdf 16 times and searched 14 times, but every mutation was rejected because it emitted an empty string in the legacy params wrapper
implementation_evidence.audit_zero_call_fix: The strict audit now treats a missing lazily-created adapter_calls.jsonl as a valid zero-call log while still requiring all LLM evidence logs; focused tests cover both cases.
implementation_evidence.osworld_evaluator_tree: frozen commit with zero tracked changes

selection.method: first non-pass in the task-ID-deduplicated development coverage ledger
